title: Ecosystem Predator-Prey Population Dynamics with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that simulates a Lotka-Volterra predator-prey ecosystem on a bounded 3D terrain with full undo/redo support.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 60, 80) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (30, 50, 20) with intensity 0.8.
- Create a flat green ground plane (100x100 units) centered at origin representing the ecosystem terrain.
- Add a subtle grid helper on the ground for spatial reference.
- Sky background color: #87CEEB.

## Entities
- PREY (rabbits): represented as small white spheres (radius 0.5). Initial population: 40. Spawn randomly on the ground plane within bounds [-45, 45] on X and Z.
- PREDATORS (wolves): represented as small red spheres (radius 0.7). Initial population: 10. Spawn randomly on the ground plane within bounds [-45, 45] on X and Z.
- FOOD (grass patches): represented as small green cylinders (radius 0.3, height 0.1) flat on the ground. Initial count: 60. Spawn randomly.

## Simulation Rules (Lotka-Volterra inspired, discrete tick-based)
- The simulation advances one TICK at a time. Each tick represents one time step.
- Each tick, every entity moves randomly by up to 1.5 units in X and Z (clamped to bounds [-48, 48]).
- PREY REPRODUCTION: Each prey has a 4% chance per tick of reproducing (spawning a new prey at its location) IF there are fewer than 200 prey.
- PREY FEEDING: If a prey is within 2.0 units of a food patch, the food is consumed (removed) and the prey gains +1 energy. Prey start with energy=5. Each tick costs 1 energy. Prey with energy<=0 die.
- PREDATOR HUNTING: If a predator is within 3.0 units of a prey, the prey is consumed. The predator gains +8 energy.
- PREDATOR REPRODUCTION: Each predator with energy > 15 has a 6% chance per tick of reproducing.
- PREDATOR STARVATION: Predators start with energy=10. Each tick costs 1 energy. Predators with energy<=0 die.
- FOOD REGROWTH: Each tick, there is a 10% chance per missing food slot (up to initial 60) that a new food patch spawns at a random location.
- Population conservation check: totalBirths - totalDeaths must equal currentPopulation - initialPopulation for each species independently.

## Controls & Interactions
- SPACEBAR: Advance simulation by 1 tick.
- SHIFT+SPACEBAR: Advance simulation by 10 ticks rapidly.
- 'R' key: Reset simulation to initial state (re-randomized positions).
- Click on any entity sphere in the 3D scene using raycasting: select it and show its info in the HUD (type, energy, position).
- DOM button 'btn-undo': Undo the last tick (restore full previous state).
- DOM button 'btn-redo': Redo a previously undone tick.
- DOM button 'btn-auto': Toggle auto-play mode (1 tick per 500ms).
- DOM slider 'slider-speed': Control auto-play speed from 100ms to 2000ms per tick.
- 'P' key: Toggle a population graph overlay (a simple canvas-based line chart showing prey count in white and predator count in red over ticks).

## Undo/Redo System
- Maintain a history stack of simulation states (deep snapshots of all entity positions, energies, alive/dead status, food positions, tick counter, birth/death counters).
- Maximum history depth: 50 states.
- Undo restores the previous state completely (positions, counts, energies).
- Redo re-applies a previously undone state.
- Any new tick after an undo clears the redo stack.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD overlay showing: current tick number, prey count, predator count, food count, total prey births, total prey deaths, total predator births, total predator deaths.
- Bottom bar with buttons: btn-undo, btn-redo, btn-auto, and the slider-speed slider.
- When an entity is selected (clicked), show a panel 'info-panel' with: entity type, energy, x/z position (2 decimal places).
- The population graph (toggled by 'P') should be a 300x150 canvas element with id 'pop-graph' overlaid at top-right.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every tick:
- tick: number (current tick, starts at 0)
- preyCount: number
- predatorCount: number
- foodCount: number
- preyBirths: cumulative number of prey born
- preyDeaths: cumulative number of prey that died
- predatorBirths: cumulative number of predators born
- predatorDeaths: cumulative number of predators that died
- selectedEntity: { type: string, energy: number, x: number, z: number } or null
- historyLength: number (length of undo history stack)
- redoLength: number (length of redo stack)
- autoPlay: boolean
- autoPlayInterval: number (ms)
- graphVisible: boolean
- entities: array of { type: 'prey'|'predator'|'food', energy: number, x: number, z: number, alive: boolean }
- populationConservationValid: boolean (true if births-deaths === current-initial for both species)
- simRunning: boolean (true after first tick)
- totalEntities: number (prey + predator + food currently alive)
physics_constraints: Lotka-Volterra discrete dynamics: prey reproduce at 4%/tick, predators at 6%/tick when energy>15. Energy conservation per entity: energy_new = energy_old - 1 + gains. Population accounting: births - deaths = currentPop - initialPop for each species. All positions clamped to [-48, 48]. No NaN in any position or energy value. History stack max depth 50.
